subproblem.title: Allard's Rectifiability Theorem 8.5.5 with Remark 5.6, from the sibling results
subproblem.statement: Assume FirstVariationRepresentation, StationaryMonotonicityIdentity, DensityExistsAE, ConstancyTheorem, VarifoldTangentCones, the blow-up density lower bound, Lemma 1.3 and FirstRectifiabilityTheorem. The blow-up density lower bound (second conjunct of the sibling varifold_tangents) says: if V has locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, τ > 0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ ofReal τ)}) → 0, then every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) has Θ^n(μ_C,·) ≥ ofReal τ μ_C-a.e. Lemma 1.3 is the sibling plane_disintegration statement. Then AllardRectifiabilityTheorem holds. That is, if V has locally bounded first variation in U and Θ^n(μ_V,x) exists and is > 0 for μ_V-a.e. x, then V is rectifiable and has a tangent plane with positive multiplicity (Def. 1.1) at μ_V-a.e. x.
subproblem.lean_statement: FirstVariationRepresentation → StationaryMonotonicityIdentity → DensityExistsAE → ConstancyTheorem → VarifoldTangentCones → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (τ : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → x ∈ U → 0 < τ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x ρ ∧ ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ} / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N)), IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∀ᵐ y ∂C.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n C.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ) → (∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), ∃ η : Euclidean N → Measure (Grassmannian N n), (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, IsProbabilityMeasure (η x) ∧ ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ S, β S ∂(η x)))) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), MeasurableSet A → (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → ∫⁻ z in A ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal (β z.2) ∂V.measure = ∫⁻ x in A, (∫⁻ S, ENNReal.ofReal (β S) ∂(η x)) ∂V.weight) → FirstRectifiabilityTheorem → AllardRectifiabilityTheorem
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Simon 8.5.5, Remark 5.6 and the printed proof (pp. 215–218): Steps A1, A2, A4 and A10 of the supplied proof. Steps A3 and A5–A7 are the sibling child stationary_cone_flat. The first half of A4 is the sibling child density_blowup_decay. Steps A8–A9 are the sibling child unique_tangent_plane. Lean names: Submission.allard_tc_stationary_cone_flat, Submission.allard_tc_density_blowup_decay, Submission.allard_tc_unique_tangent_plane. Errata applied: printed (5) reads "≥ θ0 − ε_j"; 5.2 has centre 0.

Let N, n, U and V be given, with V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation (hV) and (H): for μ-a.e. x there is θ with HasDensity n μ x θ and θ > 0. Here μ := V.weight, ‖δV‖ := variationMeasure V, ω := unitBallVolume n ∈ (0,∞), R(ρ) := densityRatio n μ x ρ.

1. Good points, Remark 5.6. Collect the following a.e. statements.
 - η from Lemma 1.3 for (N, n, U, V).
 - Θ̃ and its a.e. statement from DensityExistsAE(N, n, U, V, hV).
 - (FVR2) from FirstVariationRepresentation(N, n, U, V, hV): for μ-a.e. x, variationDensity V x ≠ ∞ and ‖δV‖(B_ρ(x))/μ(B_ρ(x)) → variationDensity V x as ρ ↓ 0.
 - μ(Uᶜ) = 0 (V.supported and Varifold.weight_apply).
 - (Dec): the conclusion of density_blowup_decay(DensityExistsAE, N, n, U, V, hV).
 Intersecting these countably many a.e. statements (filter_upwards), μ-a.e. x satisfies:
 (i) x ∈ U, (H) holds at x, Θ̃(x) ≠ ∞ and HasDensity n μ x (Θ̃ x);
 (ii) η(x) is a probability measure and for every β ∈ C(G,ℝ), (∫_{B_ρ(x)×G} β dV)/(μ(B_ρ(x))).toReal → ∫ β dη(x);
 (iii) (Dec) at x;
 (iv) (FVR2) at x.
 Fix such an x.

2. θ0. By (H) there is θ > 0 with HasDensity n μ x θ. Uniqueness of limits gives θ = Θ̃(x) ≠ ∞. Put θ0 := θ.toReal. Then θ0 > 0, ofReal θ0 = θ, and HasDensity n μ x (ofReal θ0).

3. 5.1 at x, Step A2. Put Λ := variationDensity V x + 1 < ∞, so Λ ≥ 1. By (iv) there is ρ1 > 0 such that for 0 < ρ < ρ1, ‖δV‖(B_ρ(x))/μ(B_ρ(x)) < Λ and B_ρ(x) ⊆ U (U is open). For such ρ, ‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) ≤ Λ·μ(B_ρ(x)):
 - if μ(B_ρ(x)) = 0, a quotient a/0 < ∞ forces a = 0;
 - if μ(B_ρ(x)) = ∞, the right side is ∞;
 - otherwise this is ENNReal.div_le_iff.
 Since μ(B_ρ(x))/ofReal(ρ)^n = ω·R(ρ), we get
  ofReal ρ·‖δV‖(B_ρ(x))/ofReal(ρ)^n ≤ ofReal ρ·Λ·ω·R(ρ).
 As ρ ↓ 0, ofReal ρ → 0 and Λ·ω·R(ρ) → Λ·ω·ofReal θ0 < ∞, so the right side tends to 0 (ENNReal.Tendsto.mul). By the squeeze, ofReal ρ·‖δV‖(B_ρ(x))/ofReal(ρ)^n → 0, which is 5.1 in the form used by the contract. Alternatively, (iv) can be replaced by SimonGMT Varifold.ae_exists_ballFirstVariationBound_inside. That would need import Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter08.BallVariationBound and is not required.

4. Tangent cones, Step A2. VarifoldTangentCones(N, n, U, V, x, θ0) applies with hV, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, HasDensity and 5.1. It gives:
 (a) every t_j > 0 with t_j → 0 has a subsequence along which V_{x,t_j} converges vaguely to some C;
 (b) every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) is stationary and μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = ofReal θ0·ω·ofReal(ρ)^n for all ρ > 0.

5. Density of tangent cones, Step A4 (printed (3)–(7)). Fix C ∈ VarTan(V,x). For k ∈ ℕ put τ_k := θ0 − θ0/(k+2), so 0 < τ_k < θ0 and τ_k → θ0.
 By (iii) with θ0 and τ_k, the decay hypothesis of the blow-up density lower bound holds. The lower bound, applied to (N, n, U, V, x, τ_k) with hV, x ∈ U, τ_k > 0, 5.1, the decay, C and C ∈ VarTan(V,x), gives: for μ_C-a.e. y there is θ with HasDensity n μ_C y θ and ofReal τ_k ≤ θ.
 By ae_all_iff, μ_C-a.e. y satisfies this for all k at once. These θ coincide by uniqueness of limits; call the common value θ_y. Since ofReal τ_k → ofReal θ0, ofReal θ0 ≤ θ_y. This is printed (7): for μ_C-a.e. y there is θ with HasDensity n μ_C y θ and ofReal θ0 ≤ θ.

6. Flatness, Steps A3 and A5–A7. Apply stationary_cone_flat(StationaryMonotonicityIdentity, ConstancyTheorem, N, n, C, θ0) with θ0 > 0, C stationary (step 4), the ball identity (step 4) and (7). It gives C.measure = ofReal θ0 • v(T) for some T. So hypothesis (b) of unique_tangent_plane holds at x.

7. Tangent plane, Steps A8–A9. Apply unique_tangent_plane(N, n, U, V, x, θ0, ν := η(x)) with x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, (a) of step 4, step 6, and (ii). It gives T with HasTangentPlane V x T θ0. So for μ-a.e. x there are T and θ with HasTangentPlane V x T θ. This is the second conclusion.

8. Rectifiability, Step A10 ("the required rectifiability of V will then follow from 1.2"). FirstRectifiabilityTheorem(N, n, U, V), applied to the a.e. statement of step 7, gives θ with IsVarifoldOf V M θ for M := {x ∈ spt μ : ∃ T θ', HasTangentPlane V x T θ'}. So IsRectifiable V, witnessed by M and θ. Together with step 7 this proves AllardRectifiabilityTheorem. ∎
proof_key_steps: Remark 5.6 good points: intersect the a.e. statements of Lemma 1.3, DensityExistsAE, FirstVariationRepresentation (finite D_μ‖δV‖), density_blowup_decay and μ_V(Uᶜ) = 0.
At a good x: θ0 = Θ(x) ∈ (0,∞), and ‖δV‖(B_ρ) ≤ Λμ(B_ρ) gives 5.1; VarifoldTangentCones gives compactness, stationarity and μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0ω_nρ^n.
Blow-up density lower bound with τ_k = θ0 − θ0/(k+2) (decay from density_blowup_decay); intersect over k: Θ(μ_C,·) ≥ θ0 μ_C-a.e.
stationary_cone_flat: every C ∈ VarTan(V,x) is θ0 v(T); unique_tangent_plane with η(x) gives HasTangentPlane V x T θ0.
FirstRectifiabilityTheorem turns a.e. tangent planes into IsVarifoldOf V M θ, so IsRectifiable V.
